title: Senior Data Engineer, Streaming Platform
description: Own the streaming ingestion and processing layer for a carbon-accounting platform, leading the migration from nightly Spark batch to Kafka and Flink without breaking audit guarantees.
responsibilities: Design and own the streaming ingestion layer: Kafka topics, schema registry, and publishing contracts with twelve internal teams and partners.
Build stateful stream processing in Flink for emissions calculations that must be reproducible and auditable months later.
Migrate the existing Spark batch pipelines path by path with no gaps in customer-facing figures.
Set the data quality and lineage standard for an externally audited platform.
Translate Emissions Science methodology changes into production changes.
qualifications: Deep Python and SQL, owning design as well as implementation
Production experience with a stream processing framework (Flink strongly preferred; Spark Structured Streaming or Kafka Streams considered)
Strong Kubernetes — the platform runs on EKS and engineers operate their own services
Data contracts, schema evolution and backwards compatibility in a multi-producer environment
Track record of migrating a live system without downtime
